title: This product is working
text:
My mother was diagnosed with sarcoidosis about 5 years ago and has been on oxygen since her diagnosis. She's was told by her physicians that she is in Respiratory Failure which causes severe difficulty with breathing. My father was recently diagnosed with Stage 4 lung cancer and after research I decided to purchase Oxy E. My mother has been taking her drops for about 2wks now and states she was feeling a difference on day 2. When my mother was having her good days she would set her oxygen tank on 2 when resting & 6 when active. Her breathing got so bad she could barely walk from one room to the next without gasping for air, she kept her tank on 10. Today she is able to clean house, do dishes and even walk short distances without her oxygen - something she hasn't been able to do for many years since her diagnosis. She is now able to keep her oxygen tank set on 2 even when she's up cleaning and being active.

My father stated he did not feel a difference, but I noticed he was breathing better, his eating had increased and he was even talking about adding a bit of exercise to his daily routine. I increased his drops and then his breathing became more difficult and his eating decreased 2 days later. I do not know for certain if it's the cancer or if it's due to the increase in his drops. I took him off the drops, it's been about 4 days now and I started him back today at the lower dosage. I had to research further because the information on the back of the bottle is limited on how to increase. According to my findings I may have increased too soon. I read one can gradually work up to 12 drops 10x's a day depending on severity of condition. I also do not recall the bottle stating add to 80z's of liquid - which is what I also read. Please try this product and if needing to increase dosage amount definitely research online on how to do so. Thanks!

title: Oxy E for Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)
text:
I bought Oxy E for another complaint, which only time will tell, as I have only been on it since August 17, 2010. But to my surprise, since I have been on Oxy E my Irritable bowel (IBS) symptoms have lessened by 95% within a matter of the first 10 days. I could not believe it. I have suffered IBS for 16 years and have tried everything on the planet that is natural. I will not touch the doctors chemical drugs of any kind. I believe the IBS will go completely, as the Oxy E is no doubt doing it's job by delivering Oxygen into my bowel, alleviating the symptoms.

To be able to eat without pain, then not having to run to the toilet at a moments notice is a God send. I am on my second bottle of my 5 pack, and will be ordering more, and I will never stop using this product. If my IBS has almost gone in this short space of time, then what else is Oxy E doing for me? It will be interesting to see after being on this product for 6 - 12 months as to what else has happened.

I started on 10 drops into a glass of pure water 3 times a day. Now I use 20 drops 3 times a day. I did go up to 80 drops a day, but felt nauseated, and had a headache. I did not want to suffer severe detox symptoms so I dropped down to 60 drops a day, which is comfortable for me. I drink the Oxy E first thing in the morning, 45 minutes before eating. I am not on any other product, only Oxy E.

Sonia. Queensland, Australia.

title: Product is great, accept that it no longer works
text:
So I ordered this product really early in the year. I really like the product, it’s super quiet compared to the other one I had and it’s suction is so much better. However, I put it on the charger since it died. Honestly… I didn’t think it’d be dead dead… I left it to charge for about thirty minutes, when I went to check on it it was still red. But just to be sure I took it off and tried turning it on. I would have been happy if it had turned on, but no 😑… so I put it back on the charger, this time for an hour… same result. Well I put it back on and honestly forgot about it so it’s been on the charger all day today.
You would think that it would be super charged by now and not have to be charged for a whole damn month and a half, but this snot catcher 2.0 is a gone with the wind. I haven’t even had it for a full year yet. But mostly, I’ve only used it 4 times since I bought it… and it’s little battery spirit decided that it had enough and took off…
Like I said, it’s a really good product. The only thing that bothers me is the fact that it seems to not live that long. I promise there has been no damage to my device. It’s been in its box hidden away from my toddler so that she can’t play with it, so I have no Idea why it’s dead. I tried to see if I could get a replacement, however Amazon doesn’t seem to want to give me one for a faulty product. I really love this aspirator, but I wish it would last longer. It’s been the only aspirator that my toddler likes so far and it’s convenient considering the basin being washable. I would have given the product two stars if I didn’t really like it. Overall it works really well it’s just the life of the product that sucks.

title: Good protection for your fruits against birds and small mammals
text:
I did not use these pouches the way it was originally meant to be used. But was asked by the mfg to write a review for their product. So, read my review as an alternate use of these little pouches.

I have a fruit garden with a couple fig trees, I never used these pouches before. I only purchased them to find out how well they'll work on my figs against being damaged or eaten by birds and small mammals. Birds and little mammals have a tendency to "taste test" fruits within their reach. If you wish for your fruits to ripen naturally on the trees, you'll never get to enjoy any of it. They will either be damaged before hand or partially eaten when its almost time to harvest. I've came across this product during my search for solution and decided to give them a try. These pouches are strong enough to protect against birds, and small mammals except from the determined ones. Daily, we still find some of these pouches chewed/pecked through with its contents wasted or mostly eaten. We understand nothing is 100% animal prove. Thus, this is an acceptable loss to us. At least now we are able to enjoy our fruits and share the uncovered ones with our animal neighbors.

Bottom line: It is inexpensive and worked as we expected for small sized fruits. Larger fruits may require stronger mesh material against larger animals.

title: Great affordable alternative - works with Garmin HRM
text:
I'm a triathlete, I train pretty much all-year so I use my heart-rate monitor a lot.
My OEM Garmin strap has had enough of my activities and gave in last week (after two years of hard work). I wanted to get another Garmin strap but it was relatively expensive.
Instead, I've purchased this strap, plugged in my Garmin heart-rate monitor and worked right out of the box. I tested it yesterday during a two-hour training and it held up like a champ. Given the price point, this is a great alternative.

Few more things to mention; it's nice to be able to pick a size. I wear small in men's t-shirt and I went to with small strap and worked great. The strap is even softer than the Garmin OEM strap. The metal plugs which holds the actual heart rate monitor are solid and tight; I don't expect the HRM to come off easily. The buckles which allow you to resize are plastic-coded metal - so it's pretty solid.

Even if this strap gave in, as some other folks here mentioned, in a season or two, I'd still get another one. In the long run, it'd still be cheaper than Garmin OEM strap. Happy customer so far after one use! Check out some pics.

title: OK, but annoying to work with
text:
I'm actually pretty annoyed by the design of this clock, and now wishing I went with another.

Good: It provides light in the morning, it provides radio in the morning.

Bad:
-Menu systems are horrible... I've had it for months and I still get confused how to change settings, set sleep mode, change light brightness etc...
-Buttons suck. They are on the face of the clock, and hard enough to push down that the clock just slides on my Ikea wood end table. You have to reach around the back to hold the clock to click a button, but don't reach around the right side or you will trip the snooze IR sensor.
-Snooze: speaking of snooze... Light comes one, radio gets louder... you click snooze and sleep for a few more minutes, and the next time it comes on the light stays off (radio only)?!? WTF, why would you ever want that?
-Radio "fade in": Very digital. You can hear a distinct jump in loudness every ~30 seconds. I don't know why, but it annoys me. I would prefer a smooth fade, simply because it I know it would not have been hard to design.
-Nature sounds: You can fit 100 gigs on something the size of an SD card, but you couldn't make enough memory to record more than 3 seconds of each nature sound? After listening to each on for about 15 seconds, you realize how short the noise clips are. title: Speed kills. In this era of acceleration of all ...
text:
Speed kills. In this era of acceleration of all things human, most of us intuitively understand that too much speed kills, and that addiction to speed is a death sentence. For the last several centuries, acceleration of our species’ activities has exponentially outrun the capacity of Planet Earth's natural resources necessary to maintain the pace. The marvels of our technological wizardry contribute to the acceleration while simultaneously and effectively masking recognition of the obvious.

Throw in the present-day break up of truth and moral values into fractals so numerous as to blur our recognition of larger patterns of both common and empirical sense, unquestioned adherence to the globally dominant paradigm of growth-at-any cost risks the crash of systems everywhere.

With this book on Soil and Nurture Capitalism, Woody Tasch pulls threads of wisdom from the wisest of our predecessors, strands of seminal thinking from today’s thought leaders (including his own), and weaves them into a compelling case for slowing down. The case is by no means Luddite; it is an exquisite argument for re-balancing the way we conduct our business and our relationship with the planet. Whether it's food or finance, monetarism or militarism, the economic case for paying attention to the negative externalities spawned by our addiction to speed and unfettered growth is necessary to change the helter skelter paradigm.

Soil is his litmus test for analyzing planet / human health and real wealth; soil is the antidote, the metaphor, the medium and the message.

This book is not a polemic scold…(who can stomach more of that depression)? It is at once uplifting, pragmatic, and laced with Woody’s irrepressible humor—most often wry, appropriately skewering, and on balance, ever-optimistic. Dry college texts and treatises on our current condition should aspire to deliver knowledge and wisdom in similar fashion.

Besides all that, we get to learn who Georgescu-Roegen is.

And the poetry? Ahhhhhhhhhhhh, the poetry is pure bonus.

I have used many, many beard balms and oils over the years. Honestly, to me, they are all the same. Most leave a film of gross oil on your beard that begins to collect and clump your beard together. I vowed never to buy another vial again.

Until this one.

Top Secret Beard Oil is incredible. Every aspect of the product, from the way it moisturizes and softens my beard to the aromas that are released over time is perfect. When you first apply it, it smells like woodland pine and good cologne. As the oil warms and begins to soak into your beard, notes of mint, tea tree and lavender start to emerge. It's not overpowering like many of these oils are. You'll catch whiffs of it throughout the day, but it won't ruin your lunch because you can't smell anything else. My wife also appreciates the way it softens the beard - having a wiry mess on your face is not fun for the ladies, gents.

By the way, there is a little menthol in here - which is absolutely refreshing to me.

I was given a discount in exchange for a review, which I appreciated. I had planned to be extremely... critical when I first received the product. But after a few days of using it, I'll be a customer for life.

title: Big enough to cover entire shoulder, works great! Especially for post surgery!
text: This ice pack is amazing! I’ve had multiple shoulder surgeries and previously used the cold water pack and ice bucket the doctors say to purchase every time. Filling the bucket with ice, wrapping yourself in that Velcro madness of an ice pack contraption, and then hooking the bucket to the ice pack is a royal pain in the butt. Especially if you have to do it yourself, one handed. To make matters worse, the water pack doesn’t get below 32 F (0 C), and it warms up in about 10-15 minutes. My most recent surgeon told me to avoid that and just purchase ice packs (He’s also one of the nation’s top surgeons and is fixing what other doctor’s missed on my previous surgeries). This ice pack is foldable, and fits easily in your freezer. It takes a few hours to get cold initially, but that’s a given for any ice pack. When it’s time to ice, it still remains flexible while remaining extremely cold, and slips easily into the provided fabric sleeve which protects your skin and the furniture you sit on. The instructions say to cover your skin with a towel, but I apply it directly. The ice pack can be manipulated fairly well and I’m able to conform it to contact 90% of the skin on my shoulder. The sleeve has Velcro straps for a more secure fit, but I don’t even bother with that, as the ice pack is large enough cover my entire shoulder (front and back) and conforms to it easily. I simply sit on the couch with my back against the cushion, or prop myself lying down and it stays in place the entire time. Even after 30 minutes of icing the ice pack is still cold, and I don’t have to worry about dripping water or anything leaking. This is an amazing product, especially for the price! It’s a must have for any athlete, person who just had surgery, or someone who works out. If you’re having surgery and your doctor tells you to buy the “Cold therapy machine” aka ice bucket, PURCHASE THIS PRODUCT INSTEAD AND DO NOT BUY THAT EVIL CONTRAPTION (even if your doctor insists)!

title: Uncomfortable for side sleepers
text: I purchased this product to replace another sleeping mask that had come apart over time.  This product appealed to me because of its promise to block out all light and not to put pressure on my eyes.  It does a good job of blocking light, but it is the least comfortable sleeping mask I've ever owned.  The padding around the eye socket that blocks the light and prevents the mask from pressing directly on the eye is very rigid.  It puts an uncomfortable amount of pressure on the bridge of my nose, and shifting this to make it more comfortable allows light to come in.  As a side sleeper, though, the worst part of this mask is the small metal piece on the band that allows the band to be adjusted.  When I lie on my left side, the metal piece presses against my temple.  The padding around the eyes of the mask also press into my face when lying on my side.  I've taken to wearing the mask "inside out" as a last resort while I wait for a new mask to arrive.

title: It actually works!  Dried grout on tile.
text: I bought this in a desperate attempt to clean off over-worked grout.  Foolishly I grouted late at night  (base tile) and didn't bother cleaning it off.  Big mistake.  I was left with smeared dried grout on my tile that would not budge.  There were other projects that needed to be done, and I wanted to finish the rest of the tile - so I just left the base tile as is for several weeks, figuring I would get to it when I get to it.  I discovered that cleaning off dried grout is nearly impossible.  I tried an acid based cleaner that did very little, and even the "sugar water" trick.  Surprisingly that did help a bit, but was too much scrubbing work.  THIS product worked like a charm!  I can't believe how well it works.  I wish I had before and after photos to post.  Spray it on, leave it for 20 minutes, then use a scotch brite pad.  I also had to use a plastic scraper in certain heavy areas, but now my tile is clean!  The really bad areas like the corners needed two applications, but it worked.  I don't know how this will perform for other issues, but for dried grout - this is the one!

text:
Our son is 7 lbs and around 5 ounces. The perfect fit Fuzzi Bunz XS are recommended for that weight. However, these diapers are still too large for his body, and whatever he emits leaks straight out of the legs holes. Now, this is not to say that this is a bad product. Far from it. In fact, we love this diaper and can easily see that when he grows a bit more the fit will be fantastic and there will be no problems whatsoever. However, at this point in time, the only thing that will fit him properly are swaddlers and unfortunately we will have to wait on using these Fuzzi Bunz size XS until later.

It is also important to mention that there is no need to purchase any special laundry detergent if you have a good washing machine. My husband and I have simply thrown in the dirty Fuzzi Bunz into the washer, using Arm & Hammer Sensitive dye/perfume-free, put the washer on the eco heavy duty setting and these diapers come out perfectly clean each time. Easy.

title: Best shaker bottle I have used for its size
text:
The cyclone cup arrived on time and in great condition. I like the design of the bottle especially the detachable shaker part attached to the cap; it makes it really easy to clean which is really important for protein drinks and smoothies.
Every morning I make a meal replacement drink (Amazing Meals Vanilla Chai) and a fruit and veggie smoothie with my Nutribullet. I originally bought this to store my meal replacement drink to drink it for lunch, but since I put pureed pumpkin and ground oatmeal in addition to the meal replacement powder, no amount of shaking would make it as smooth as I needed it to be (aka Nutribullet smooth). So I switched up my routine to have my meal replacement as breakfast and the fruit and veggie smoothie I now drink throughout the day as a snack to keep me going until dinner. I put the fruit and veggie smoothie into my cyclone cup. It usually separates within an hour with the roughage floating to the top. A couple good shakes in this bottle and everything is all smooth again. I did use the cyclone cup when I made a mini meal replacement with just the meal replacement powder and milk and the cyclone cup blended it up perfectly. It was as smooth as could be expected with that type of grainy meal replacement. The only other shaker bottle I have used was the blender bottle and I like this one much better except that the cyclone cup is a bit small.
The cyclone cup comes with a detachable bottom cup like container. I originally put my protein powder in there and put the milk in the bottle to keep it separated until I was ready to drink it because I find that this meal replacement gets thicker as it sits. When I unscrewed the bottom compartment it was a MESS. There was powder everywhere at my desk, but honestly it was to be expected just by looking at it, so that was mostly my fault. The next day I tried to just put some of my supplements and vitamin pills in it, but every time I shook the bottle it was like playing maracas and I got some annoyed glances from some of my co-workers :) I have now just completely detached the bottom part and travel with just the bottle which is okay because its smaller size fits in a lot more places. It has not spilled, leaked, or anything like that. Overall it is a great product and it has been a great addition to my new healthy lifestyle!

title: Gentle Wake Up
text:
I have found this alarm clock to be a much gentler way to wake up than with a typical buzzer or radio station. It is a pleasant change to wake and not be startled.

Some of the other light alarm clocks only offer buzzers for the alarm. I think a buzzer would ruin the calm of a gentle light awakening, so I prefer to use one of the nature sounds instead.

The lamp can be used as a dimmable lamp, so it is nice to also have a dimmable bedside lamp now.

There are quite a few configuration options, so you will probably need to keep the instruction sheet nearby for a couple days.

title: Waking up is so much more gentle and enjoyable now!
text:
I recently moved to Alaska, and decided to get a sunrise-type alarm clock to make getting up on these dark mornings a little easier. After researching several that are available, I decided to try this one because of the features available and the fact that I can change the bulb myself (I had read in reviews of other brands that the bulbs burn out quickly and then people have trouble getting it repaired). I've had this alarm clock for a little more than a month, and while it's not perfect, it's very very nice.

Here's what I like about it: I like being able to set the brightness of the light, but it did take a little trial and error to figure out the best setting for me. It's nice to be able to set so many features, like how loud the volume will be, which nature sound to wake up to, and to be able to have preset radio stations to choose from. After some time, I got comfortable with how to change the settings (it did take a little practice, though), and I learned that you don't have to step through every option just to change the alarm time. After choosing the alarm time, just hit the "mode" button 2 or 3 more times to get out of the "change settings" mode. I also like how not only does the light gradually get brighter before your set alarm time, but the volume also starts quietly and gradually increases to the selected volume.

What I don't like (these are admittedly picky, but I feel they're worth mentioning): I wish I had more options for how long before my alarm time the light begins getting brighter. The only option is 15 minutes. It seems sufficient, and isn't a big deal, but more options would be nice. Also, I like having the screen illuminated all the time, but it seems that if you use the dimming feature when going to sleep, it will turn that screen off. Since I don't usually have trouble falling asleep, I just don't use that feature so that the screen will stay illuminated.

After looking at the features that the other "sunrise" alarm clocks have, it seems like this one has the most features for the money. I don't think I've had it long enough to know if I really feel more rested when I wake up, but regardless, it's so nice to wake up already used to the light and to wake up gradually rather than by the sudden beeping of an alarm clock. I would recommend setting a backup alarm for the first little bit until you get used to the settings and being sure the alarm is actually turned on (watch for the little bell symbol). It seems to be very reliable when I properly set it.

title: A Need in the Winter Months
text:
Since I live in the north, winter mornings are miserable. It's so hard to wake up to my alarm clock, that I had to put 4 alarm clocks on my phone and two on my regular alarm.

I decided to get this alarm clock because of the great reviews and decent price. The instruction manual is a little confusing but if you read it a couple times through, it makes perfect sense.

The alarm clock itself is great. I'm normally a hard and deep sleeper so I was worried that I would sleep through it. However, for some reason I cannot sleep through it. The only problem I've had so far is just the bright display but that be turned off. Not a huge deal for me at all.

Overall, this product is great. It wakes me about 10 minutes before I need to get up so it gives me extra time. It's quiet for others and it won't wake the next door neighbor. title: Alarm broke :-(
text:
I received this alarm clock as a gift, and I was happy to get it because I live in NW Washington where it is gray, dark, rainy, and dreary for 5 months out of the year. This winter was especially bad and I was having a super hard time getting up in the morning. I had this unbelievably loud and obnoxious alarm clock that I would hit the snooze button on 8 times every morning.

What I loved about this alarm clock is that the alarm would gradually sound, starting out very quiet and gradually getting louder. I would still wake up with the quietest setting, however. Also, the light that goes on before the alarm is nice and seems to make me feel more awake and ready to get up and start the day. Sometimes the light wakes me up before the alarm does.

But, just the other day, the alarm started malfunctioning and now when it goes off, it immediately goes to the loudest setting (which is exactly what I hated about my old alarm clock). If I hit snooze, the next time it goes off it's just a quick "chirp," which is definitely not enough to wake me if I were to fall back asleep. I have no idea how to fix this and I will probably have to go back to using my old alarm clock, which sucks. Even though the light still wakes me up with this clock, I don't want to use it if the alarm isn't dependable.

Otherwise, I liked this clock. It is somewhat cheap quality (buttons, etc.), but it's not bad. The settings really aren't that complicated if you just take 2 seconds to read the manual and go through them. The LED screen is a tad bright, but it doesn't bother me. The radio is pretty crappy sounding, but I don't use it anyway. My only other complaint is that the snooze is a little too easy to activate, some days I would wake up wondering why I only remembered waving my hand in front of the snooze thing twice, yet I had overslept by 3 or 4 snooze cycles.

title: Gets the job done
text: I have a hard time waking up in the morning.  What I really wanted was the gradual light feature, which works well for me.  Then I use another alarm clock to acutally wake me up, as the nature sounds are too soothing for me at moderate levels (so I sleep through them) and too annoying for my husband at higher levels (so I don't use them).  The gradually increasing light doesn't hurt my eyes like sudden light does, so by the time the other alarm goes off, I'm ready to wake up.  The radio is preprogrammed to pick up 30 stations, but only picks up one station with a lot of static, so I don't use it at all.  Manually adjusting the station finder is not an option.  Some of the nature sounds aren't very natural sounding, so I don't use them either.  But a couple of the bird sounds are pleasant.  I would like, however, if they were on a longer repeat loop, as it only lasts a few seconds and then repeats over and over again, which is fairly monotonous.  I can't use the snooze feature, as it also turns the light off, and when the alarm comes back on, the light doesn't, which defeats the purpose for me, as I need the light to help me wake up.  When you set the alarm, you have to be careful to make sure it's also turned on (a separate operation), or it won't work.  Given these restrictions, it's not all it claims to be, but it gets the job done for me.

title: Lovely ❤︎ ❤︎
text:
❤︎ Skin: Normal, younger, extremely pale Caucasian skin with pink tones and relatively small to medium pores.

This is such a wonderful cleanser, definitely my new staple beauty cleanser. 😃😋😍 I recently got in the whole Korean skincare cosmetics over the summer!! Sadly, I've only tried 2 Korean cleansers in my lifetime and they gave me pretty bad results. They were It's Skin eggshell (which dried me out terribly and gave me the most worst breakout on my forehead) and Skin Food Egg White Cleansing Foam (which was a sample I received that also dried my skin out horribly and left me with a more mild breakout on my forehead). So, I was a bit worried this would dry me out as well!!! 😓😓😓

I have thankfully never experienced any kind of acne, and really rarely only get mild breakouts with products, usually on my forehead, but this may be because I keep a healthy diet and I'm quite young too! But prevention is the key! 😘😘😃😃

Sorry for the rambling, now on to the product! 😌😌😅😅 Wonder Pore Whipping Foaming has such a cute, refreshing packaging. It comes in a shaving cream-like bottle with an adorable baby blue hue. I'm usually a more pinkish and girly type girl but Wonder Pore is just so delicately cute and feels new and refreshing! The consistency is also like shaving cream, it reminds me of marshmallow fluff! 😄 It's extremely gentle, and it was my first time using a foam cleanser so it was definitely a new and pleasant experience! There's definitely a smell, but extreme'y subtle. Usually when I use this cleanser under my nose and upper lip I can detect a mint, maybe peppermint-like feeling? It's super refreshing and cooling and really subtle! I also have rather sensitive skin, but this doesn't irritate it at all! Soo lovely!! 😄😄 At first, I thought this was product was "too" gentle, so I scrubbed more vigorously. Don't be fooled! This scrub is actually a bit tough! After scrubbing vigorously for maybe 2 or 3 days even using toner and moisturizer I've noticed that my nose developed some teeny tiny dry flakes! They were tiny though, definitely not horrible! But other than that, everything has been peachy with this cleanser! It's fluffy and sweet, leaving my skin very soft and clean, but not super tight, squeaky clean. It looks adorable on my sink and has definitely cleared and has really reduced the size of my pores! I've been using this for a few weeks now and it's really improved my skin! Also, the shipping was extraordinarily fast! I ordered this on October 30th and it arrived November 1rst on a Sunday too!! I ordered around maybe 16-18 products? and this along with Hey!Pinkyo Girl lace sheet masks and they were the first things to arrive! This is by far my most adored cleanser, and I'm finally seeing the hype! ❤︎ I also really love Wonder Pore because of that cute video with Sulli and Key reviewing Wonder pore products! 😍😍😍 Will definitely repurchase!!

TL;DR
Pros:
Very gentle, yet effective
Extremely subtle mint-like(?) smell
Refreshing mint lingering
Cute container
Leaves pores smaller
Keeps face soft and firm
Can be used as a mask
Cleans your skin without stripping

Cons:
Can dry out skin a bit if you use vigorously

Overall; Holy grail and definitely not a beauty fail!! 😍😍😍😍😍😍

title: Works as expected, great customer support
text:
I installed the new battery, and thought that it was defective because the toothbrush would only work for 1-2 seconds before shutting off. I contacted customer support, and they replied within 1 hour immediately asking if I'd like a replacement unit sent out. I said yes, and in a few days I got the replacement battery.

I started replacing the "defective" battery, this time while looking through a microscope. I found out that one of my solder joints was not actually joined to the battery lead, but was resting against it (my fault). That explains why the toothbrush would work for 1-2 seconds before shutting off, likely due to vibrations shaking the battery lead away from the joint.

I fixed my bad solder joint, and the toothbrush works now. It has been a couple weeks and it's still running strong.

Long story short, soldering can be tricky if you don't have good eye sight and a small iron tip, the battery works well, and customer support is very responsive if you need help.

title: People who can't coordinate with their hands & hair
text:
I was super excited for this product. I have naturally curly hair, but do not know how to have nice curls, or do my hair using a curling iron or curling wand or even curl it with a straightener. I was on some social media site when I came across this product. I looked it up on Amazon and bought it. I tried it yesterday then tried it again today. The difference between the two days were, yesterday the machine didn't start smoking and today it did. So it's a big concerning.

Another thing is when I received the product, the box has a broken piece of plastic, not sure what it goes to. The USB is white with black spots on it, the electric hair wand was not covered in plastic or wrapped in a plastic bag. Little things such as these is a reason I took off a star. I don't know if the product is used or not. I immediately turned the power button off because smoke was coming out of it & I kind of got scared because yesterday I tried it at the same heT @200 degrees and I didn't notice or see smoke.

Overall, I do like the product. I just have to practice by watching you tube videos & trying to figure it out. I have a bit of a chubby face, so with my trial on Saturday, my hair looked so good, like a professional without getting burned and positioning hair or putting the straightener towards the air & turning it etc.. but I think mine came used, so I find it as a downfall other than that I think it is a great product.

It's like how people who can't dance because they have two left feet, this is the same but for people who have either two left hands or two right hands when it comes with working with hair 🙋. It's a good time saver.

title: Worked well with modifications
text: I was originally looking for a gel seat cushion for a long road trip, but because of the price I decided to give this a try. When it arrived I took it for a short trial run and I'm sure glad I did! I'm a woman that wears a size 8 in pants, so I'm not tiny but not overly large either... this cushion hugged me like it was made exactly for my size. I can't imagine that it would be very comfortable for anyone larger than me. It also raised me up higher than I expected and it seems it would be a problem for someone tall. So anyway, I set out and soon felt claustrophobic. It felt very much like those child booster seats that close you in with a buckle. I couldn't wait to get out of it! Rather than pay the return shipping fee, I decided to make the best of it. Fortunately I was able to remove the inner and outer covers (a nice feature) and I then used a sharp, serrated bread knife to carve the memory foam. I pretty much removed all the bumps, humps, and ridges, leaving a nice flat, slightly forward-angled pad. And after putting the covers back on, I put it back into the plastic bag it was shipped in so that I could more easily slide in and out of the car and/or shift positions while driving. So I have just come home after spending about 30 hours driving solo and I can happily report that my backside had a pleasant journey! One more important thing though-- the extra height of the cushion raised my back above the correct curve of the bucket seat, leaving a big gap. So I used a small pillow for lumbar support and was very comfortable. Was all of that worth it? Yes, I do think so!

title: BEST sleep mask of all time!
text: I have used many sleep masks in the past and with every single one, I would take them off in my sleep. Never had I made it through the night with it still on my face. So.... when I read all the wonderful reviews about this mask, I ordered it, although honestly I was only cautiously optimistic that it would be as great as the reviews said it would be. Well, it arrived quickly and when I opened it up I didn't see what was so great about it. It was definitely thin and soft..... just like the reviews said, however, the strap that holds it on felt like it was going to slip right off my head while sleeping. HOWEVER..... when I went to bed that night, I put it on. It was soft, and light and really really comfortable. When I woke up in the middle of the night to get a drink of water, it WAS STILL ON!!!! I hadn't taken it off in my sleep like I'd done with every single other night mask. I got some water and went back to bed. I turn a lot in my sleep and I thought that since it was so soft and silky it would turn and twist on my head. IT DOESN"T!!!! It stays exactly where it is supposed to be. And here's another thing that is so wonderful about this mask. The strap doesn't bother the top of my ears like all of the other ones do. With the masks that have straps made out of elastic, they feel like they are digging into the place where the top of my ears connect to my head. (Sorry I don;'t know what to call that part) This mask doesn't do that at all. Well, I've been wearing it now for about a week and I LOVE LOVE LOVE it!!!! It's silky and soft and thin and comfortable. It stays in place and I NEVER take it off in my sleep. When I wake up in the morning it is still exactly where it was when I put it on the night before. I'm tempted to buy a bunch of them just to have in case they company ever decides not to  make them any more. And, if I could give this make 10 stars.... I would. I highly recommend it to anyone who wears or wants to try wearing a sleep mask!!!

title: Just What I Was Looking For!
text:
I was very happy with my plastic DenTek Breath Remedy tongue scraper which I bought about ten years ago. Unfortunately, being made out of plastic, my old tongue scraper eventually broke. When I went looking for a replacement, I was discouraged to discover that they truly don't make them like they used to. While my old tongue scraper did a great job of, well, scraping the gunk off my tongue, the plastic tongue scrapers one finds in stores today (even those made by DenTek) are so flexible at the neck that they don't adequately bite into the gunk to scrape it off. I went through the frustrating experience of buying several different plastic tongue scrapers only to find they all suffered the same problem.

Fortunately, I discovered the Tongue Sweeper on Amazon.com and found that it had been the answer for other people who had run into the same problem as myself (as idiosyncratic as the "problem" might seem to others). After purchasing the titanium Tongue Sweeper, the item was shipped to me promptly. Then came the true test: Would the Tongue Sweeper have the "bite" I had been looking for? The answer is yes - it scrapes the gunk off and does a better job than even my old DenTek tongue scraper. Not only that, but being made out of titanium, my Tongue Sweeper is extremely lightweight and so durable that, unless I lose it, I'll never have to buy another tongue scraper again. Finally, unlike plastic tongue scrapers, the Tongue Sweeper is can be run through the dishwasher, making regular sanitization a snap.

If you have run into the same problem as I did, the Tongue Sweeper is the answer.

title: Great way to learn stress management and lower blood pressure
text:
It doesn't take much to increase medical bills if anxiety, stress, and blood pressure are a concern. Instead of spending an hour waiting for your doctor and then additional expense on prescriptions, use that time to learn breathing and relaxation techniques that you can use most anywhere.

This is not a quick fix, not a gimmick, it takes practice and patience, and the program gives you immediate feedback on your progress, and has the option to keep a history of your gains. There are various exercises and challenges. I found some easier than others, so each person is likely to run into something that will keep interest going for a long time to come. I anticipate it will be a while before I master all of the possibilities.

There are multiple levels of difficulties. If over the course of a year, a person spent 100 hours on this program, that comes out to about $3/hour to learn lasting stress reduction approaches that are built on natural principles, that can be used anywhere.

A good set up will help a lot - comfortable chair, quiet room, minimal external stimulation and interruption. Think of it as "quiet time" with yourself. Noise cancelling headphones can be used to shut out distracting sounds as needed. Others may have different experiences, but for me at least 30 minutes/session has worked, a couple of times/week. I find myself looking forward to it. I've done it as much as an hour at once, with rewarding progress. The better I get while hooked up to Healing Rhythms the faster I am able to induce relaxation while away from it.

The program instructions mention something that is absolutely true. If you are the competitive type and try to outwit the program, you won't get very far. The harder your try, the more you impede your progress. You learn quickly that "less is more."

If you are serious about managing unhealthy stress, are willing to do your part and take the time to pay close attention to your body and teach yourself natural approaches, Healing Rhythms will do its part to take you on that journey as far as you want to go.

I know there are other approaches for controlling blood pressure naturally. I haven't tried any others. This is to say that Healing Rhytms isn't the only way to achieve such goals, but so far my experience is that it is a good one.

No, I don't work for Nerdwax, and no, I'm not getting anything from writing this review except the satisfaction of being able to talk about how much I've loved using this stuff. I bought one stick and use it regularly, and whenever I break it out to apply some wax on my frames, I ask my friends if anyone wants some. Inevitably, the stick gets passed around and people love it. I would definitely recommend this product to anyone with glasses.

title: TL;DR, does it boost energy or quality of life? No, it's as effective as dollar store multivitamins.
text:
The world is full of millions and millions of snake oil salespeople, and with the rise of health jargon and random buzzwordy extracts and supplements, the fact that as of this review the product is no longer available is no surprise.

I remember first falling into the fad of energy supplements when Stacker 2 first came on the scene. Did Stacker 2 do what it said it would do? Yes. It also apparently did a lot more things, which is why it got in a lot of trouble. Since then, between fat pills, energy shots, and protein powders, if you want a full look into what's effective and what's hogwash, you'll spend a doctorate-degree's worth of time cross-referencing the past 40-ish years of conflicting "your word vs. mine" research. And what you'll arrive at is the same ol' thing: EAT RIGHT AND DRINK LOTS OF WATER AND DO AEROBIC EXERCISE.

And so, I took this during a period of time where I was in physical therapy, where I had to recover the ability to do basic exercise. I took this along with eating right, drinking a jug of water a day, and starting an Arms-And-Abs 30 day challenge. I noticed NO real change in my energy levels; my medicine still knocked me out if I had to take it, my energy during workouts didn't increase, and my overall health did not improve at a higher rate than when I did the same thing using "Totes Definitely Not One-A-Day Because It Has A Funny Moustache" dollar store multivitamins.

What improves your energy levels? Processing the energy that food gives you better. What helps that? Improving your metabolism, improving your diet to simpler and healthier things, and a healthy balance of sleep and physical activity.

This pill doesn't help with any of that.

title: Like having Letizia in the kitchen with you, a true delight!
text:
I am lucky enough to be able to call Letizia my friend, imagine how delighted I was when she announced that she had produced a book of recipes from her kitchen to ours ... I couldn't wait to get my hands on a copy and met Letizia over a glass of wine and a lovely chat ... What a sumptuous luscious book it is! With beautiful photographs by Ruurd to feast your eyes on, the recipes that have been tested, tried and true - I have had the utmost pleasure in taking a couple of her entertaining, delicious cooking classes and to now be able to have a virtual Leti in my kitchen, explaining the recipes as we cook - is priceless! I have begun working my way through the recipes and each one I have tried has come out exactly as it should - the photos in A Kitchen With A View and my photos are the same! My favourite so far is the incredibly simple but amazingly tasty Fried Artichokes - I had a glut of artichokes in the garden and this was the way we used them all up - we couldn't get enough of them!
Throughout A Kitchen With A View, when something needs further explanation, Letizia instinctively knows when this is necessary - her love and enthusiasm for cooking, for life, for Umbria, for the artisans of Umbria shines through in this gorgeous book and it makes a wonderful gift for any food lover!

I'm only eating chicken or beef once a week.  I cut out all junk food, sugar, processed carbs, etc...basically tons of salad and a little meat/eggs.  What also helps is slightly boilling cruciferous vegetables and then chopping them up so that you can just down them with water.  Think food is your medicine at this point.  I learned my lesson. title: Renewable Enery Solution
text:
Let me start by setting the stage: I do not smoke, and I only carry this lighter when I go out, it gets little use at my place of residence.

However many of my friends, family, and complete strangers do smoke, and I love offering this alternative renewable energy electric lighter solution when somebody asks "Got a light?".

Now the product, it gets three stars for being innovative, this can easily be combined with a solar power USB charging system, if you're going to smoke might as well conserve natural resources (and $$$ on bics or generic gas lighters). And Two Stars for working properly, holding a charge, and charging indicator LED so you know when to charge, and when charging is complete.

-1 Star for the construction, The heating coil gets very hot and when you release the ignition mechanism a piece of plastic sits right above the cooling metal, it hasn't burned this plastic piece yet but it gets light use as of now. Also you know those times you step on something on the floor that you didn't see and it breaks to pieces under your foot, like a plastic hair clip with "teeth" or a pair of sunglasses? This lighter would bust like that if left in a pocket and that clothing was stepped on, however I have no evidence to support this claim, just a hunch and common sense. I also worry about the spring in the sliding mehcanism going out, which initializes the heating sequence.

Lastly this cannot be used with pipes, safely. However it can be combined with a glass dabber to mimic the effects of vaporizing, just last night it was dubbed the "pocket vaporizer".

Video Review available on request in comments.

I am African American with relaxed hair. I purchased this brush to expedite the straightening process. Typically, I blow dry or wrap my hair after washing. Yesterday I decided to blow dry my hair and use the Apalus brush. I was pleasantly surprised by the performance of this brush. My natural hair is fine and I chose to relax it for manageability, so I'm certain that this brush would work well on my natural hair.

The trick is to separate your hair into small sections and hold the end while brushing down on the hair. Holding the end of the hair provides additional tension needed for best results. I would use this on a preteen or an older child without hesitation. The temperature goes up to 450 degrees, so it will work well on different types of hair. It worked well on my hair because I have shoulder length hair which allowed me to grasp my hair and maintain proper tension. I brushed each section several times to get the hang of it. Just go by what you see to achieve the desired results.

Needless to say, I am pleased with my purchase!

text:
I've depended on energy drinks to get me through the day of a busy life of work & studying.

Various products haven't hit the spot quite like Neu has. I've gone through all the usual canned energy drinks, shots, and a combo of those with coffee.

I believe I've found the only product I need now. I got the 5 variety pack and my favorite flavors have been Tropical Punch and Electric Grape.

Upon trying for the first time (half shot) I felt a feeling of improved focus, concentration, and clarity.

The drink doesn't have the "twitchy" feeling that other energy products give, which is surprising given Neu does have caffiene in it. I believe the formula is a balanced mix of ingredients that provide a smoother feeling of energy.

I've used Neu for working at home and later on in the day running errands on the same shot and get no fogginess or crash. I've also used it recently on a hike with my partner and mixed with my water with no feeling of fatigue after the hike.

I would highly recommend this product for anyone looking for that extra "kick" in their day when the usual regiment of coffee or other energy product doesn't help.

I'll definitely be using this going forward.

When I asked why, he told me that my toilet connectors did not fit the connectors to the bidet.

Like the comment from another reviewer, The one "place" on our bodies that deserves real cleanliness goes unattended if not using bidet. It is downright amazing that bidets have not caught on in this country.

Bidets help us more sanitary. We will have less clogged sewers and we will help the environment by not flushing too much paper towels. The downside: the multimillion dollar toilet paper industry sales will go down and the plumbers will have less sewer unclogging to do which will not help the economy :-)

title: The cookie recipe is excellent - with this package
text: I teach 5th grade students in Illinois.  We read and article about using insects as a protein source for our future diets.  The article argued how insects took less space and energy resources to raise, but when prepared for a dietary resource contributed much needed protein.  The students wrote argument papers for, or against, eating insects.  The majority of the class, to my surprise, argued "for" eating insects!  So I ordered this cricket flour to make the vanilla chocolate chip cookies from the website's recipes.  The cookie recipe is excellent - with this package, it made about 48 cookies.  I was, however, under-educated on what happens when you bake a massive amount of cricket flour in the oven - it smells like you just put a 1,000 insects on a cookie sheet and roasted them.  But - I wouldn't consider that a deterrent from seriously participating in insects as a protein source.  It's more like a head's up to open your kitchen windows prior to baking with cricket flour.  So, hot out of the oven, the cookies were awesome at first bite, but super-foreign to the taste-buds after that.  However - the next day, I brought the cookies to school.  25 of 27 students ate them.  I ate another one.  We all agreed they were super good - so I'd recommend (if using the cookie recipe) letting them cool and "settle" prior to eating.  The product packaging is excellent, and the contents - the cricket flour - comes at a super-high quality.  Keep going Cricket Flours LLC!  My students and I agree with the concept of supplementing our diets with insects!

title: Highly effective posture training tool
text: I've suffered with terrible posture my entire life and now in my early 30s I've finally decided to do something about it. I've been wearing the product for 3 weeks now and there is already a notable difference - I feel taller and more confident, and it has already begun to alleviate my persistent lower back pain. What I especially like about this product is that it is not a 'brace' per se - it does not actually support you. What it does is act as a constant and very effective reminder and forces you to use your own muscles to open your chest and keep your shoulders down and back. This actually allows you to build the muscle strength that all of us with bad posture are lacking, and will allow you to keep good posture long after you stop using the device. The key here is to be consistent with it. I started with 20 mins a day and am already wearing it for over an hour each day with no discomfort. Very highly recommended.
